passage:
M: The room upstairs is open, but there’s a study group next door. Can we rehearse the bells here and just play quietly?
F: No ringing indoors today. We can practice the hand movements without bells. The courtyard is free after six if we want to hear the actual notes.
M: Some players have to leave by six. They need help with the change from two bells to one.
F: Start with that change upstairs. After six, I’ll take the remaining players outside to hear how the last notes sound together.
passageZh:
M：樓上的房間空著，但隔壁有讀書小組。我們可以在這裡排練鈴，放輕聲音就好嗎？
F：今天室內不能敲鈴。我們可以不用鈴練手部動作。如果想聽實際的音，六點後庭院有空。
M：有些團員最晚六點就得走。他們需要練怎麼從兩支鈴換成一支。
F：先在樓上練這個轉換。過了六點，我會帶剩下的團員到戶外聽最後幾個音一起奏出來的聲音。

title: Questions 68–70

standaloneStems: Number 68. Why is the suggestion to play quietly upstairs not accepted?
Number 69. How will the leader help players who cannot stay past six?
Number 70. What will the remaining players check in the courtyard?
